experiment: E3c physics-structured correction and physics-guided label placement

rules.target_model: Reddy TSDT; physics loss FSDT (as E3b)
rules.selection: tail-aware: minimize max(validation median / 1%, validation p95 / 3%); ties by median (as E3b)
rules.primary: M-S: multiplicative (k h)^2 correction with shear-share-weighted label placement
rules.Q1: M-S beats physics only P: 95% bootstrap CI of median paired difference (P - M-S) > 0 at N = 10, 20, 40
rules.Q2: M-S beats data only D (random labels): CI of median paired difference (D - M-S) > 0 at N = 10, 20, 40
rules.secondary: Q1/Q2 for the other five variants; placement contrasts X-R vs X-S and form contrasts G vs A/M; Q3 smallest N meeting target
rules.consistency: P, D and G-R must reproduce E3b (P, D, Hc) validation metrics
